# Good Semantic Examples
# This file demonstrates proper use of triggers, effects, and scopes

namespace = semantic_good

# Example 1: Valid triggers
semantic_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0001.t
	desc = semantic_good.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		# Valid character triggers
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		is_alive = yes
		age >= 16
		gold >= 100
		prestige >= 50

		# Valid scope chain triggers
		liege = {
			is_alive = yes
		}

		# Valid boolean logic
		OR = {
			has_trait = brave
			has_trait = ambitious
		}

		NOT = {
			has_trait = craven
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0001.a
		# Valid effects
		add_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 50
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Example 2: Valid effects with scope chains
semantic_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0002.t
	desc = semantic_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# Valid effects
		save_scope_as = actor

		# Valid scope chain effects
		liege = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = root
				modifier = grateful_opinion
			}
		}

		# Valid list iterations
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			add_gold = 10
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0002.a
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# Example 3: Valid scope chains
semantic_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0003.t
	desc = semantic_good.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		# Valid scope chains
		liege = {
			is_alive = yes
			primary_title = {
				tier = tier_kingdom
			}
		}

		# Valid multi-level chains
		father = {
			exists = yes
			is_alive = yes
			liege = {
				is_ruler = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0003.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# Example 4: Valid list iterations
semantic_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0004.t
	desc = semantic_good.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		# Valid any_ iterator (trigger context)
		any_vassal = {
			is_adult = yes
			has_trait = ambitious
		}

		# Valid any_ with complex conditions
		any_courtier = {
			age >= 16
			NOT = {
				has_trait = lazy
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		# Valid every_ iterator (effect context)
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
			}
			add_gold = 10
		}

		# Valid random_ iterator
		random_courtier = {
			limit = {
				age >= 16
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0004.a
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# Example 5: Valid saved scopes
semantic_good.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0005.t
	desc = semantic_good.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# Save scopes for later use
		save_scope_as = actor

		liege = {
			save_scope_as = my_liege
		}

		# Use saved scopes
		scope:my_liege = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = grateful_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0005.a
		# Use saved scope in effects
		scope:my_liege = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}
}

# Example 6: Valid exists checks before operations
semantic_good.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0006.t
	desc = semantic_good.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		# Good practice: check exists before is_alive
		father = {
			exists = yes
			is_alive = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		# Good practice: exists check in limit
		if = {
			limit = {
				liege = {
					exists = yes
				}
			}
			liege = {
				add_gold = 100
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0006.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Example 7: Valid character comparisons
semantic_good.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_good.0007.t
	desc = semantic_good.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		# Correct: Use 'this' for character comparison
		NOT = {
			liege = {
				this = root
			}
		}

		# Valid comparison with saved scope
		any_vassal = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = potential_rival
			NOT = {
				this = root
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_good.0007.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}
